mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits multiple CYP450 enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP3A4) which may increase chloroquine levels and toxicity risk; both drugs can cause peripheral neuropathy and CNS effects.
action: Monitor for signs of chloroquine toxicity (visual disturbances, neuromuscular weakness, arrhythmias) and consider dose adjustment or increased monitoring intervals.
